name: Consumer Cellular
notes: Researched from public consumercellular.com support FAQs and the plan page (rendered with a headless browser; the support pages now load without the bot check that blocked tier 1). Postpaid monthly invoices, due about 19 days after mailing. My Account sign-in uses the cellphone number and a password (temporary password sent by text or email on the Create Password page); no second factor is documented (mfa none, inferred). Online payments are credit or debit card only (Pay Now in My Account); checks go by mail to the P.O. boxes listed (include the account number), and card payments can be made by phone at (888) 345-5509. Paying without logging in is a texted secure link (text #PAYMENT to 38882821), not a web form, so guest_pay is unsupported online with that note (channel phone, since the format has no text channel). AutoPay charges a credit or debit card on the due date; no bank draft is documented, so autopay.methodTypes [card] and billing.methods [card]. Billing Type lets customers choose Paperless Billing, Extended Detailed Billing ($2) or Standard Paper Invoicing. Plan prices on the public plan page already include a $5 credit for AutoPay and eBilling. Late fee $5 (Broadband Facts label). Canceling: any time, through Customer Support (no online cancel documented; cancel_service unsupported, inferred); charges on the final invoice are not prorated. Scheduled payments and payment arrangements are not documented and are left to the family default. GAP: the SMS payment link cannot be modelled as a guest channel.

guest_pay.note: To pay without logging in, text #PAYMENT to 38882821 from your phone for a secure payment link, or call (888) 345-5509 to pay by card.

autopay.note: AutoPay charges your credit or debit card automatically on each invoice due date; you still receive a monthly invoice.

autopay_cancel.note: Change your Payment Type under Edit Billing Info in the Billing menu, or call (888) 345-5509.

paperless.note: Under Billing Type choose Paperless Billing, Extended Detailed Billing ($2) or Standard Paper Invoicing; the change applies to your next invoice.

cancel_service.note: Call Customer Support at (888) 345-5509 to cancel. Service continues to the end of the billing cycle; the final invoice is not prorated. New customers can cancel within 30 days (500MB) under the Risk-Free Guarantee.

pay_by_phone.note: Call (888) 345-5509 with your account number and credit or debit card.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check with your account number to Consumer Cellular, P.O. Box 6139, Carol Stream, IL 60197-6139. Allow 8-10 days for mail.

change_plan.note: Your invoice uses the plan in place on the last day of the billing cycle.

notes: A $10 network activation fee applies per new line, and an Operational Compliance Fee ($3.99 per phone) appears on invoices.

help.title: How do I make a payment?
paragraphs: Card payments: log in to My Account and select Pay Now, call (888) 345-5509, or text #PAYMENT to 38882821 to receive a secure payment link without logging in.
Checks: mail your check with your account number to one of the Consumer Cellular P.O. boxes (for example P.O. Box 6139, Carol Stream, IL 60197-6139).
Card payments post the same day; allow 8-10 days for a mailed check.

help.title: What is AutoPay and how do I sign up?
paragraphs: AutoPay charges your credit or debit card automatically on each invoice due date. You still get an invoice every month.
Published plan prices include a $5 monthly credit for using AutoPay together with eBilling.
steps: In the Billing menu, click Edit Billing Info.
Enter your credit or debit card.

help.title: When is my invoice balance due?
paragraphs: Your invoice posts to My Account about 4 days after the billing cycle ends and is generally due 19 days after it is mailed. AutoPay accounts are charged on the due date.
Text #BALANCE to 38882821 for your balance and due date. To move your due date, contact Customer Support.

help.title: Consumer Cellular plans
paragraphs: Single-line plans with unlimited talk and text: 1GB for $20, 5GB for $25, Unlimited for $35 a month when the account holder is 50 or older, and Unlimited for $60 a month for ages 18-49. Prices include the $5 AutoPay and eBilling credit and exclude taxes and fees.
If you change plans mid-cycle, the next invoice uses the plan in place on the last day of the cycle.

extra.intent: Using Consumer Cellular support pages, find the monthly charge for Extended Detailed Billing. Do not change your billing type.
Find out on which day Consumer Cellular AutoPay charges your card each month. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: AutoPay charges the card on the invoice due date.

extra.intent: Find the short code you text #PAYMENT to for a Consumer Cellular payment link. Do not make a payment.
